## Performance

We hope that one noticable difference of climwin v2.0 will be an improvement in performance.

```{r}
ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = bench_results,
            ggplot2::aes(x = max_range, y = median, colour = expression),
            linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = bench_results,
            ggplot2::aes(x = max_range, y = median, colour = expression),
            shape = 21) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic()
```
